summary: Retrieve Salesforce metadata while enforcing .forceignore for bundle sub-paths
description: Wraps sf project retrieve start, then restores any changed paths protected by .forceignore. This protects DigitalExperienceBundle, LightningComponentBundle, and AuraDefinitionBundle leaf paths that the Salesforce CLI can write as part of composite retrieves.
flags.source-path.summary: Salesforce project path where retrieve should run
flags.source-path.description: Defaults to the current working directory when omitted.
flags.metadata.description: Passed through to sf project retrieve start --metadata. Example: DigitalExperienceBundle:site/PHP_Portal1.
flags.manifest.description: Passed through to sf project retrieve start --manifest.
flags.wait.summary: Minutes to wait for Salesforce retrieve completion
flags.strict-ignore.description: Protected paths are still restored before the command fails.
flags.normalize-meta.description: Formats JSON with two-space indentation and a trailing newline before forceignore restoration.
output.title: Smart deployment retrieve
errors.strict-ignore: Retrieve touched %s .forceignore-protected path(s). Workspace was restored, but --strict-ignore requires failure.
